title: ELEPHANT'S FOOT
en: The most dangerous thing in the world still lies beneath Chernobyl.
Fuel, sand and concrete fused into lava.
That lava flowed into the rooms below, and set solid.
Months later, workers found it. It was shaped like an elephant's foot.
It got its name: the Elephant's Foot.
At first, standing near it for just five minutes was enough to kill you.
No one could get close, so a camera was sent in on wheels.
Today it is weaker than before, but it is still deadly.
And for the next hundred years, it will stay under this arch.
